project.name: learn-claude-code
project.description: Teaches agent harness engineering through 12 progressive Python sessions (s01-s12), each adding one mechanism to a minimal agent loop. Includes a Next.js web app with interactive visualizations.

nodes.summary: Claude Code instructions describing project structure, session progression, web app architecture, and CI setup.

nodes.name: s01_agent_loop.py
nodes.summary: Session 1: The core agent loop pattern -- a while loop that calls the LLM, checks for tool_use, executes bash commands, and appends results. Foundation of all sessions.

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Core agent loop: calls client.messages.create with tools, appends assistant response, executes bash on tool_use, appends results, repeats until done.

nodes.name: run_bash
nodes.summary: Sandboxed bash execution with dangerous command blocking (rm -rf, sudo, shutdown) and 120s timeout.

nodes.name: s02_tool_use.py
nodes.summary: Session 2: Tool dispatch with named handlers (bash, read_file, write_file, edit_file) routed through a TOOL_HANDLERS dict instead of inline execution.

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Agent loop with TOOL_HANDLERS dispatch: looks up handler by tool name, calls with block.input, handles unknown tools gracefully.

nodes.name: s03_todo_write.py
nodes.summary: Session 3: TodoWrite planning pattern. The model creates, updates, and reads a todo list before each action, giving it explicit task tracking.

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Agent loop with TodoWrite tool: the model manages a todo list to track pending/in_progress/completed tasks.

nodes.name: s04_subagent.py
nodes.summary: Session 4: Subagent isolation. The parent can spawn child agents with fresh message contexts and a filtered tool set; only the final summary returns to the parent.

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Parent agent loop with task tool: spawns run_subagent when task tool is called, otherwise dispatches base tools.

nodes.name: run_subagent
nodes.summary: Spawns a child agent with fresh messages[], SUBAGENT_SYSTEM prompt, and CHILD_TOOLS. Runs up to 30 iterations, returns only final text summary.

nodes.name: s05_skill_loading.py
nodes.summary: Session 5: On-demand skill loading. SkillLoader class parses SKILL.md files from a skills directory, extracting frontmatter for descriptions and full content on demand.

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Agent loop with skill listing/loading tools: the model can browse available skills and load their content dynamically.

nodes.name: SkillLoader
nodes.summary: Parses SKILL.md files with YAML frontmatter. Methods: get_descriptions() lists all skills, get_content(name) loads full content.

nodes.name: s06_context_compact.py
nodes.summary: Session 6: Context compression with three layers: micro_compact (shrinks old tool_results), auto_compact (full summary at token threshold), and manual compact tool.

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Agent loop with three compression layers: micro_compact before each call, auto_compact at threshold, manual compact on trigger.

nodes.name: s07_task_system.py
nodes.summary: Session 7: Task system with TaskManager class. CRUD operations on JSON-persisted tasks with dependency graphs (blockedBy), status transitions, and dependency auto-clearing.

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Agent loop with task CRUD tools: create, get, update, list_all backed by TaskManager.

nodes.name: TaskManager
nodes.summary: Task CRUD with dependency tracking. Persists as task_*.json files. Methods: create, get, update, list_all, _clear_dependency.

nodes.name: s08_background_tasks.py
nodes.summary: Session 8: Background tasks using threading. Long-running operations run in daemon threads, results collected via BG.drain_notifications() injected before LLM calls.

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Agent loop that drains background notifications and injects them as user messages before each LLM call.

nodes.name: s09_agent_teams.py
nodes.summary: Session 9: Agent teams with MessageBus. Multiple agents communicate via JSONL inbox files. Supports send, broadcast, and read_inbox operations.

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Lead agent loop that reads the MessageBus inbox and injects messages before LLM calls. Can spawn and broadcast to teammates.

nodes.name: MessageBus
nodes.summary: JSONL-based message bus with per-teammate inbox files. Methods: send, read_inbox, broadcast.

nodes.name: s10_team_protocols.py
nodes.summary: Session 10: Team protocols with plan_approval, shutdown_request, and shutdown_response. Teammates run in threads with structured communication protocols.

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Lead agent loop with team protocol tools: plan_approval, shutdown_request, shutdown_response for structured team coordination.

nodes.name: s11_autonomous_agents.py
nodes.summary: Session 11: Autonomous agents with a SharedBoard for cross-agent state coordination and finite-state machine phases (idle, poll, claim, work).

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Autonomous agent loop with SharedBoard coordination, FSM state transitions, and task claiming from a shared board.

nodes.name: s12_worktree_task_isolation.py
nodes.summary: Session 12: Worktree isolation for multi-agent teams. Each agent gets a dedicated git worktree, preventing filesystem conflicts. Combines TaskManager, MessageBus, and worktrees.

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Full agent loop with worktree isolation: each agent operates in its own git worktree directory with TaskManager and MessageBus.

nodes.name: s_full.py
nodes.summary: Capstone reference combining all mechanisms from s01-s11: tool dispatch, subagents, skill loading, context compression, task system, background tasks, and message bus in one integrated agent.

nodes.name: agent_loop
nodes.summary: Full-featured agent loop integrating all mechanisms: tool dispatch, subagent spawning, skill loading, context compression, task management, background tasks, and message bus.

nodes.name: SkillLoader
nodes.summary: Integrated SkillLoader in the capstone. Parses SKILL.md files with YAML frontmatter for on-demand skill loading.

nodes.name: TaskManager
nodes.summary: Integrated TaskManager in the capstone with full CRUD and dependency tracking via JSON persistence.

nodes.name: MessageBus
nodes.summary: Integrated MessageBus in the capstone for inter-agent JSONL-based communication.

nodes.name: run_subagent
nodes.summary: Integrated subagent spawning with fresh context, filtered child tools (bash, read, write, edit), and summary-only return.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md and CLAUDE.md to understand the 12-session progression and how the Python agents and Next.js web app fit together.

tour.title: The Core Agent Loop (s01)
tour.description: Study s01_agent_loop.py -- the fundamental pattern: a while loop calls the LLM with tools, checks stop_reason, executes tool calls, appends results, and repeats. agent_loop() and run_bash() are the only two functions you need to understand.

tour.title: Tool Dispatch and Planning (s02-s03)
tour.description: s02 introduces TOOL_HANDLERS dict for dispatching named tools (bash, read, write, edit). s03 adds TodoWrite for explicit task planning. Both extend the same agent_loop pattern.

tour.title: Subagent Isolation (s04)
tour.description: s04 adds run_subagent(): spawning a child with fresh messages[] and filtered tools. Only the summary returns to the parent. This is the key isolation pattern for context management.

tour.title: Skills, Compression, and Tasks (s05-s07)
tour.description: s05: SkillLoader parses SKILL.md files for on-demand knowledge. s06: Three-layer context compression (micro, auto, manual). s07: TaskManager with JSON persistence and dependency graphs.

tour.title: Concurrency and Collaboration (s08-s12)
tour.description: s08: Background tasks via threading. s09: MessageBus for team communication. s10: Structured protocols (plan_approval, shutdown). s11: Autonomous FSM agents with SharedBoard. s12: git worktree isolation.

tour.title: Capstone: All Mechanisms Combined (s_full.py)
tour.description: s_full.py integrates everything: tool dispatch, subagent spawning, SkillLoader, context compression, TaskManager, background tasks, and MessageBus in one 90-symbol file. The definitive reference for the full architecture.

tour.title: Web App: Interactive Visualizations
tour.description: The Next.js web app brings the sessions to life. Each session has a step-through visualization (s01-agent-loop.tsx through s12-worktree-task-isolation.tsx) driven by useSteppedVisualization hook and StepControls. The SessionVisualization registry in visualizations/index.tsx ties it all together.
